resources.string: Vzato
Reminders may come late
Allow Alarms & reminders for Vzato so that every reminder comes right on the minute.
Change it in Settings › System › Languages › App languages.
Your data stays on this phone. Nothing is collected.
The phone may stop reminders
Battery saving can delay or stop Vzato\'s reminders. Let Vzato run without restrictions.
Do Not Disturb
To hear reminders during Do Not Disturb, open the Medication reminders settings and let them override Do Not Disturb.
Next reminder check: %s
Bought a new package? Tap the medication in Medications and change Amount at home.
If Settings shows The phone may stop reminders, tap Open settings and let Vzato run without restrictions.
If Settings shows Reminders may come late, allow Alarms & reminders for Vzato.
Check that the phone is not on silent or vibrate only, and that the volume is up.
Backup
Save all medications and their history to a file, for example on Google Drive or a USB stick, and restore it on a new phone.
Save a backup
Restore from a backup
